Anup Bagchi.bio: With the ICICI Group since 1992: MD & CEO of ICICI Securities (2011–16), Executive Director of ICICI Bank (2017–23), then MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life (Jun 2023 – Oct 2026). IIT Kanpur engineer, IIM Bangalore MBA. RBI-approved three-year term at HDFC Bank, 27 Oct 2026 – 26 Oct 2029.
previous: MD & CEO, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance (2023–2026)
Anup Bagchi.education: B.Tech, IIT Kanpur · MBA, IIM Bangalore
Anup Bagchi.so_what: An outsider from HDFC Bank's closest rival, with retail-broking and insurance distribution DNA.

Bahram Vakil.bio: Co-founder and senior partner of law firm AZB & Partners; practice spans restructuring, insolvency, infrastructure and project finance. Has served on government committees on financial-sector reform, FDI and securities markets. Columbia LLM; qualified in India and New York. Already on Trent's board as a non-executive, non-independent director.
previous: Vice-chairman & independent director, Tata Investment Corporation
Bahram Vakil.so_what: An existing board insider and lawyer, not an operator — continuity at the board, no change to the executive team.
